facts.fact: 敲门笑话的“幽默”（如果有）全靠悬念：一个普通名字要怎么变成一句关于进门的陈述
facts.anchor: The humour, such that there is any, lies in the suspense – how is this normal-sounding name going to be transformed into a statement about getting through a door?

facts.fact: 作者顺手开了一个玩笑：发明敲门笑话的人得了“no-bell prize”，谐音 Nobel Prize（诺贝尔奖）
facts.anchor: (In fact, the person who invented the knock-knock joke won the no-bell prize.)

facts.fact: 作者认为最好的一条敲门笑话是对形式的自我颠覆（Interrupting cow）
facts.anchor: the best one out there is a subversion of the form

facts.fact: 长毛狗故事是很长很长的笑话，包袱通常极其虎头蛇尾，或者根本没有包袱
facts.anchor: Shaggy dog stories are long, long jokes, usually with incredibly anticlimactic punchlines or a total lack of them.

facts.fact: 其乐趣很大程度上来自讲者胆敢浪费所有人的时间、只换回极少的回报
facts.anchor: A lot of the fun in them comes from the audacity of the teller wasting everyone’s time for such minimal reward.

facts.fact: 据说马克·吐温很喜欢这类笑话，但“shaggy dog”这个名字要到 1930 年代才出现
facts.anchor: Mark Twain was said to be a fan, although the shaggy dog name only came about in the 1930s

facts.fact: 这类故事不要求逐字背诵，它只是一个松散的框架，讲者可以随意发挥（跑题、插话、过度细节、文学典故）
facts.anchor: They’re not meant to be recited word for word – they exist as loose frames for the teller to do what they want with.

facts.fact: “一个人走进酒吧”是极其高效的开场：两个陌生人被情境绑在一起，必须对话
facts.anchor: ‘A man walks into a bar’ is an incredibly efficient setup for funny events.

facts.fact: 全球最受喜爱的酒吧笑话（马走进酒吧、酒保问“为什么拉长脸”）放在哪儿都能成立，只是在酒吧更好笑
facts.anchor: The most beloved bar joke in the world (‘A horse walks into a bar. The barman says, ‘Why the long face?’) could take place anywhere, but is just funnier in a bar.

facts.fact: 研究“鸡为什么过马路”的学者很多，他们分歧在于：它是刻意反高潮，还是一个涉及鸡之死的混乱宗教寓言
facts.anchor: Academics who have studied it – and there are a lot of them – are divided, in fact, as to whether it’s deliberately anticlimactic or some sort of confusing religious allegory involving the chicken dying.
